description:
State document, in Arabic script. A decree fragment, more precisely. Only four fragmentary lines preserved. Seems to be in response to a plea concerning the return of taxes (zakāt?) or maybe the belongings of someone (tarikāt?). Also mentions the return of officials? to their respective deployment positions (mustaqarr khidmatihim), and imposing a restriction on someone (shadd). Needs more examination. 

The verso also seems to be a recycled Arabic document, probably a petition, later reused for a text in Hebrew script. Needs examination.
description_he: מסמך בערבית ברקטו, אולי מדינה. מהתקופה הימי-ביניימית. חלק קטן של ארבעה שורות נראה. דורש בחינה נוספת.
